output.population: 7447 adults aged 55-80 years in Spain who were at high cardiovascular risk but had no cardiovascular disease at enrollment.
output.intervention: Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil or Mediterranean diet supplemented with mixed nuts.
output.intervention_or_exposure: Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil or mixed nuts.
output.comparator: Control diet with advice to reduce dietary fat.
output.outcome: Major cardiovascular event: myocardial infarction, stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes.
output.effect: In adjusted intention-to-treat analyses, hazard ratio versus control was 0.69 (95% CI 0.53 to 0.91) for Mediterranean diet plus extra-virgin olive oil and 0.72 (95% CI 0.54 to 0.95) for Mediterranean diet plus nuts. Primary events occurred in 3.8%, 3.4%, and 4.4% of the olive-oil, nuts, and control groups, respectively.
output.applicability_boundary: Applies to older adults at high cardiovascular risk without cardiovascular disease at enrollment in this Spanish trial; protocol deviations affected randomization for some participants, and revised analyses adjusted for these issues.
output.source_span: the hazard ratio was 0.69 for a Mediterranean diet with extra-virgin olive oil and 0.72 for a Mediterranean diet with nuts

uncertainties: The revised report identified protocol deviations affecting randomization in some participants and used analyses not relying exclusively on full random assignment.
